title: update_image_tag
description: Updates the container image tag for a specified image in a Kubernetes manifest, Helm values file, or Docker Compose file.

image.description: The container image name (without tag) to update (e.g. 'nginx', 'gcr.io/my-project/my-service', 'quay.io/org/app').

tag.description: The new image tag to apply (e.g. 'v1.2.3', 'sha256:abc123', 'latest').

file_path.description: Optional path to the specific file where the image tag should be updated. If omitted, all relevant manifests in the repository will be scanned.
